abilities.name: Shoot
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack using your equipped ranged weapon (bow/gun/thrown). Requires a ranged weapon.
abilities._source: Placeholder scaling (Kyle's call, 2026-09-05): flat effect_value + Ranged Attack Power*0.5 + ranged weapon roll, mirroring the existing melee Attack formula. Revisit alongside the OG9 base-ability balance patch, not before.

abilities.name: Wand
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack using your equipped wand. Requires a wand.
abilities._source: Placeholder scaling (Kyle's call, 2026-09-05): reuses the existing spell_damage formula (effect_value + spell_power*1.5 + wand roll), fixed Arcane school since items don't carry a damage_school field yet. Revisit alongside the OG9 base-ability balance patch, not before.
abilities._balance: 14 Nov 2026, playtest: 'the first priest's wand ability is doing 1.5 to 2x my druid's damage on attack... don't have to use smite, just wand everything to death.' Measured: Wand 29 at level 1 against a druid's Attack 15 and a warrior's 20, for no mana and no cooldown. The flat 20 was most of it. At 8 the wand sits level with a druid's swing and under a warrior's, and still grows with spell power and a better wand. SECOND PASS, the same evening: the playtester's level 17 priest was hitting for 115-135 with gear on. The flat number was not the real cause; the wand took spell power at the full spell coefficient of 1.5, so every point of caster gear made the free auto-attack grow as fast as Smite. A WoW wand does not scale with spell power at all. At 0.3 it still notices gear, and the wand itself is what makes it hit harder.
